messages:
sam-support: heads up, support ticket INC-8821 from customer 'Storify' reporting repeated 502/504s and timeouts for hosted inference in eu-west starting ~09:05 UTC.

deploy-bot: canary deploy for inference-gateway v2.14.3 completed at 09:04 UTC.

lisa-sre: I'm oncall — joining. Can someone drop traces or a repro?

sam-support: customer pasted a quick curl repro that just hangs or returns 504:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-like-13b","input":"ping"}' -v
```
They report majority requests timeout, some 502s.

mike-eng: grabbing metrics — gateway p95 latency jumped from ~100ms to ~1.6s at 09:06-09:10. Upstream inference queue depth spiked, several backends returning "upstream response timeout" 502s.

jess-runtime: checked runtime fleet in eu-west — one kv-cache pod died (OOM) at 09:03 and restarted. Cache warmup not complete when traffic hit. That will cause a cold-cache storm.

chris-platform: auth-proxy (token validation) shows Redis RTT spikes to ~1.2s during the window — auth delays amplify gateway queuing.

lisa-sre: working hypothesis: kv-cache OOM -> cache-miss storm -> backend saturation -> auth/redis slowdowns -> gateway queues -> 502/504 surface. Need fast containment.

mike-eng: containment plan (execute now):
- Route affected tenant to smaller model variant (gpt-mini-6b) to cut backend work.
- Temporarily increase gateway route timeout for eu-west from 3s -> 8s.
- Scale inference pool +3 nodes (hot add).
- Pin kv-cache to last stable image to avoid churn.
- Enable tenant-level early-reject circuit at 70% queue depth.

sam-support: confirmed with customer they accept a temporary fallback to gpt-mini-6b while we stabilise. I'll notify.

deploy-bot: scale request submitted: scale inference-pool-eu-west +3 by @mike-eng.

jess-runtime: pinning kv-cache image to registry.redwood/kv-cache:2026-01-11-hotfix-1 and triggering rollout:
```
kubectl set image deployment/kv-cache kv-cache=registry.redwood/kv-cache:2026-01-11-hotfix-1 -n eu-west
```

chris-platform: applied route timeout via feature-flag: hosted.gateway.eu-west.timeout=8000ms. PATCH command executed against feature-flags service.

mike-eng: applied routing override for tenant storify -> gpt-mini-6b using rollout API:
```
POST /api/rollouts
{ "customer": "storify", "route_to": "gpt-mini-6b", "duration": "45m" }
```

support-bot: INC-8821 updated: mitigation steps in progress (fallback routing, timeout bump, scaling). :white_check_mark:

sam-support: customer reports immediate reduction in 504s and can complete requests, but some slower tails remain.

jess-runtime: after kv-cache image pin and restart, cache warmup metrics show hit-rate climbing back to baseline over ~6 minutes, backend queue depth normalised.

lisa-sre: containment verified. Moving to RCA/longer-term actions.

mike-eng: preliminary RCA summary — root cause chain: kv-cache pod OOM -> large cache-miss storm -> inference backend overload -> Redis/auth RTT spikes -> gateway queueing -> 502/504s exposed to customers. Contributing issues:
- No automated cache warmup/prefetch after restart.
- Gateway timeout defaults too low for short overload spikes.
- No fine-grained per-tenant backpressure to shed heavy traffic.
- Insufficient alerting on kv-cache restarts + miss-rate surge.

sam-support: drafting postmortem for Storify and internal SOC. Need owners for action items.

action-items (owners + target dates):
- [jess-runtime] implement post-restart cache prefetch/warmup and validate warmup latency (target 2026-03-29).
- [chris-platform] make gateway per-route timeout configurable and adjust default to be more defensive (target 2026-03-24).
- [lisa-sre] implement per-tenant queue-depth backpressure + early-reject at 60% threshold (target 2026-03-21).
- [mike-eng] add alerting for kv-cache restarts, cache-miss-rate spikes and correlate with backend queue depth (target 2026-03-18).
- [eng-qa] add load regression test simulating cold-cache storm to CI (target 2026-04-02).
- [sam-support] customer follow-up note and postmortem summary to Storify + SOC (target 2026-03-20).

mike-eng: paste of key logs to include in postmortem:
```
[09:03:11] kv-cache-2 OOMKilled, kube restarted pod
[09:04:05] gateway p95 latency from 120ms -> 1.6s
[09:05:12] inference backend queue depth at 92%
[09:06:30] support tickets noting 502/504s from Storify
```

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollback for inference-gateway v2.14.3 if error rate > 1.5% over next 20m.

lisa-sre: created Jira tickets for each action item and assigned owners. I'll own verification for the backpressure rollout.

sam-support: closing this incident channel for active containment. Will reopen if we see regression. Postmortem link will be posted to #postmortems and I'll DM the SOC and customer when ready. Thanks all. :pray:

-- thread note: containment achieved, RCA draft captured, action items assigned. Postmortem to be published to #postmortems when written.
